description: All 12 Path of Exile 1 Campaign Labyrinth Trials (6 Normal, 3 Cruel, 3 Merciless). Tracks Locked -> Unlocked -> Completed status.

trials.layout_hint: Hug outer perimeter walls from the Waypoint room.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 2 — Chamber of Sins Level 1 WP → Take Map Device hallway to Level 2
trials.layout_hint: Usually spawns in the NE or SE wing opposite Fidelitas.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 2 — The Crossroads WP (go SE through Fellshrine) or The Crypt Level 1 WP
trials.layout_hint: Optional side-zone SE of Crossroads; hug outer walls to find the Trial book.
Spawns along the main outer loop before reaching Piety.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 3 — The Marketplace WP (entrance is right beside the WP)
trials.layout_hint: Optional side-zone right next to The Marketplace Waypoint.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 3 — The Imperial Gardens WP → Head North-West
trials.layout_hint: Always in the North-West hedge maze section from the Gardens Waypoint.
Search the outer corridors from the Act 6 Lower Prison Waypoint.
On Level 1 of The Crypt before taking the stairs to Maligaro's Map.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 7 — Chamber of Sins Level 1 WP → Take Map Device hallway to Level 2
trials.layout_hint: Complete on your way to the secret passage to The Den.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 8 — Solaris Concourse WP → Enter The Bath House
trials.layout_hint: Spawns along the outer Northern/Western rooms of The Bath House.

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 9 — The Tunnel WP (Trial is usually 1 screen from the WP)
trials.layout_hint: Almost always spawns right next to The Tunnel Waypoint!

trials.waypoint_hint: Act 10 — The Ravaged Square WP (entrance is right beside the WP)
trials.layout_hint: Enter The Ossuary right beside the Ravaged Square Waypoint; loop the upper level.
